messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU-serving cluster 'gpu-pool-prod' queue length > 10k and token throttling observed. Escalation level: P1. Paging on-call SREs @maria.sre @katy-oncall :rotating_light:
maria.sre: I'm on it, grabbing recent metrics. Can someone post prom-adapter logs?
alex.ingest: seeing a backlog on the hpa/custom metrics pipeline: prometheus-adapter returning 500s to HPA. Sample error from adapter pod: `error fetching metrics: Get \"http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query\": read tcp 10.0.0.12:45432->10.0.0.21:9090: i/o timeout`
dinesh.mlinfra: also looks like prometheus scrape backlog spiking, retention spike. Prometheus CPU at 95%. Query latency super high.
maria.sre: HPA target for gpu-inference svc is using custom metric `queue_length`. HPA not triggering because adapter returns no metrics -> metricUnavailable. That prevents horizontal scaling.
katy-oncall: customers are already seeing 429s and slow completions, support ticket inflow rising. Jordan, can you get an impact estimate?
jordan-support: confirmed multiple customers on dedicated and hosted are reporting timeouts for long inputs. Severity elevated in a handful of accounts. I'll compile list and notify sales if needed.
maria.sre: immediate mitigations: 1) try to restore adapter -> restart prometheus-adapter 2) if adapter recovery slow, perform manual scale up of inference replicas (kubectl scale) to relieve immediate queue 3) route critical traffic to smaller model variant / dedicated pool. Opinions?
alex.ingest: +1. I can attempt a rolling restart of prometheus-adapter. Doing: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter`
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: rollout restart for deploy/prometheus-adapter by alex.ingest at ts 1978003475
alex.ingest: adapter logs after restart show initial OOMs in one replica: `OOMKilled` followed by CrashLoopBackOff. Looks like adapter restarted but lacks memory margin.
dinesh.mlinfra: prometheus pressure likely caused adapter OOM due to big instant queries. We should scale adapter replicas and temporarily reduce query load. Patch: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/prometheus-adapter --replicas=3`
maria.sre: scaling adapter to 3 now. Also adding a short scrape retention rule to reduce query cost.
katy-oncall: manual scale plan: how many inference pods can we spin before hitting GPU quota? Current HPA maxReplicas=12, current replicas=8, GPU pool has maxNodes=10 (8 usable GPUs). If we scale beyond HPA, we might hit cluster quota.
dinesh.mlinfra: I'm checking cloud GPU quota. Looks like we've hit autoscaler limit due to max nodes setting at 10. We can temporarily raise node pool max to 14 but it takes ~3-4 mins to provision nodes. Raising it now.
maria.sre: while nodes spin up, do a manual cordon/evict? No, we need capacity. I will manually scale deployment to 12 replicas to absorb queue spikes and allow time for nodes. `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/gpu-inference --replicas=12`
alex.ingest: scaled to 12; pods pending because Pending->ContainerCreating waiting on GPU resources. Node provisioning is in progress (cloud console shows creating 4 nodes).
jordan-support: customer impact note: adding teams tracking list. Early customers on region us-west-2 impacted: acct-42, acct-73, acct-9. Notifying CS.
deploy-bot: nodepool autoscale API: increased max nodes gpu-pool-prod from 10 -> 14 by dinesh.mlinfra at ts 1978003560
maria.sre: adapter metrics coming back but slowly. HPA observed metrics reappearing for `queue_length` at 1978003602. HPA now able to scale, but it will obey maxReplicas=12. If quota lifts we should let HPA finish.
dinesh.mlinfra: nodes are ready (3 new), kubelet reports GPU allocatable increased. Pending pods now scheduling.
katy-oncall: monitoring: queue length dropping but still elevated (~4k). Token throttling reduced, 429s trending down. Any leftover throttles?
jordan-support: tickets rate decreasing, I'm keeping customers updated. No escalations yet.
maria.sre: follow-up: root cause hypothesis: prometheus queries for custom metric had a slow query pattern (expensive instant vector over many time series) that spiked adapter memory; adapter crashed causing HPA to see no metrics -> HPA froze -> queue grew -> GPU pool exhausted. Plan: 1) tune prom query, 2) add circuit-breaker on HPA (fallback to target CPU-based scaling), 3) add backfill/metric cache for adapter to serve stale metrics for short windows.
alex.ingest: created a quick hotfix to adapter deployment with larger memory request: `resources: requests: memory: 1Gi limits: 2Gi` and added `--metric-cache-ttl=30s` flag. Rolling update in progress.
dinesh.mlinfra: I'll open a follow-up ticket to analyze which PromQLs caused big cardinality. Temporary rule: add a recording rule to preaggregate queue_length per service to reduce cardinality.
katy-oncall: handoff: I'm going to sleep in 15min. @maria.sre can you take next on-call window? If anything regresses, escalate to infra/eng-ml.
maria.sre: taking handoff. Current state: prometheus-adapter stable (3 replicas), HPA resumed scaling, nodes up to 14, gpu-inference replicas at 12 and dropping as load decreases. Queue length 800 and decreasing. Leaving a runbook checklist in incident board.
jordan-support: compiling customer impact summary for postmortem, ETA 30m.
maria.sre: adding timeline to incident doc and scheduling postmortem. Preliminary severity P1 -> P2 by 1978003888. No data loss, service degraded.
incident-bot: Incident state update: "mitigated" by maria.sre at 1978003888. Postmortem requested: assign to dinesh.mlinfra + alex.ingest + maria.sre.
katy-oncall: thanks team, nice coordination. :thumbsup:
